decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the firm’s core lighting systems in a growing industry, the LED track spotlight is likely to be retained because there is no clear sign of underperformance and the firm’s broad portfolio and relationship-based strategy provide enough slack to keep a still-new line.

The LED ceiling luminaire is also close to the established offer and was actively presented, so under behavioral-theory logic the firm is likely to keep it unless results clearly fall below aspiration levels, though the somewhat standard product category makes withdrawal slightly more plausible than for A.
